program.strategy: Translate with actual attitude to the central bowl workspace before considering one object-centered attitude change.

state.feature_source: GPT-authored program; not an independent sensor

x.instructions: For axis x, read state.processed_features.axes.x.goal_relation only. Choose positive for increase, negative for decrease, and hold for within_tolerance. Other axes do not determine this answer. Program-authored policy: For world axis x, use state.processed_features.axes.x.goal_relation: increase means positive, decrease means negative, within_tolerance means hold. Follow measured hand residuals, not an imagined object pose.

criteria.negative: Decrease this world coordinate or world rotation-vector component.
criteria.hold: This axis is within its supplied deadband.
criteria.positive: Increase this world coordinate or world rotation-vector component.
